hero.title: Statements in.
hero.text: Import a statement from Nubank, Sicredi, Mercado Pago or Will Bank (PDF, OFX or CSV). AI sorts each expense by category; you just check.

preview.title: Statement imported
preview.aria: FlowTrack preview: Nubank statement imported. {{first}} categorized as {{firstCat}} by AI with {{firstPct}} confidence; {{second}} as {{secondCat}} with {{secondPct}}. In the month's flow, income splits into housing, food, transport and other categories, and {{pct}} is left over.

demo.title: Explore a sample account
demo.text: Twelve months of transactions, three accounts, goals and investments, ready for you to try.
demo.hint: No sign-up. Sample data that stays in your browser.
demo.error: The demo couldn't be opened. Reload the page and try again.

login.divider: or sign in with your account

errors.network: We can't reach the server right now. The demo works without it.
errors.unconfirmed: Confirm your email using the link we sent before signing in.
errors.rate: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.unknown: We couldn't sign you in. Try again.

unavailable.title: Signing in isn't available in this version.
unavailable.text: This public version runs without a server; the demo has every feature.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.text: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.

errors.network: We can't reach the server right now. Try again later.
errors.rate: You requested a link a moment ago. Wait a few minutes before asking for another.
errors.unknown: We couldn't send the link. Check the email address and try again.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.text: If there's an account for {{email}}, you'll get a link to set a new password.
sent.spam: Nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam folder or request another link.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.text: Choose a new password for your account.

errors.network: We can't reach the server right now. Try again later.
errors.samePassword: Your new password must be different from the current one.
errors.weakPassword: That password is too weak. Mix letters, numbers and symbols.
errors.unknown: We couldn't save the new password. Try again.

reset.invalidText: Reset links expire quickly and work only once. Request a new one to continue.
reset.unavailableText: This public version runs without a server, so there are no accounts to reset. The demo has every feature.
reset.doneText: Done. Use your new password from now on.
